race.description: Angullong Wines Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: EDDY THE GREYT (5) finds a very thin contest second up after sitting on the pace from a wide gate on debut with a game third over 1000m at this track. Fitter now and doesn't have to find much to win this. NIGHTWALKER (11) thirty-nine start Maiden who looks to get a much better set-up for this. Covered plenty of ground in the run with a fighting sixth over 1000m at this track. Generally runs well second up and drops sharply in weight from a low gate. Must respect. TIMELESS LOVE (13) Peltzer filly out of Infinite Love on debut for the David Smith yard. Wasn't that far away in her latest trial over 900m at Scone. Worth thought from the good barrier. ANDERS DIAMOND (6) gelded over the break after disappointing on debut with a fading eleventh over 1000m at Dubbo last May. Leading apprentice rides and goes into the exotics.
